name: forever-crisis
description: Forever Crisis, an unofficial fan project: walk the world of FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS again, rebuilt from your own Steam install.

scripts.build:app: cd app && npm ci && npm run build && cd .. && node scripts/finish-dist.mjs
scripts.test: cd app && npm test && cd ../api && npm ci && npm test && cd .. && node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs
scripts.build: cd app && npm ci && npm run build && cd .. && node scripts/finish-dist.mjs
scripts.bicep: az bicep build -f infra/main.bicep --stdout > /dev/null && az bicep build-params -f infra/main.bicepparam --stdout > /dev/null
